name: @tearleads/client-sdk
description: React-free Tearleads runtime with atomic document/container writes, placement-aware persistence notifications, required revision-CAS host adapters, unified device-first handles, explicit retained-folder recovery, signed-name group mutations, verified organization policy history details without persisted names, verified keying, held-descendant re-citation, sync, encrypted blob storage, root operator identity/organization billing and data usage lookups, typed registration refusals, typed folder path-length refusals, typed stale keyring-override refusals, and teardown predicates for host diagnostics. Includes compact public projection authorization and paged principal-history recovery with offline evidence, strict Admins verification and private local key custody.
